question: Which Indian music composer received his second Grammy award in 2022 for the album 'Divine Tides'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ricky Kej.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian music composer who received his second Grammy award in 2022 for the album 'Divine Tides' is Ricky Kej.**
 
• Ricky Kej is a Grammy-winning composer,** music producer, and environmentalist** from Bangalore, India.
 
• **He won his first Grammy award in 2015 for his album 'Winds of Samsara', which he co-created with South African flautist Wouter Kellerman.**
 
• 'Divine Tides' is Kej's** sixth studio album**, which features collaborations with musicians from around the world and explores themes of spirituality, nature, and social justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Producer and mix engineer **P.A.Deepak works in the music industry.

 
 
• **His "Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media" win at the 2010 Grammy Awards was for the film Slumdog Millionaire.**
 
 
 
• **Manoj George **is a** violinist and composer** from India.
 
 
• **He participated in the production of two albums in 2022, Winds of Samsara and Divine Tides, as conductor, string arranger, solo violinist, and choral arranger. **
 
 
 
• **The first Indian woman to receive a Grammy is Tanvi Shah.**
 
 
• Her debut song was "**Yakkai Thiri"** for the film Aayutha Ezhuthu.
